summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Osisko Development Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, containing its management information circular for an annual and special meeting of shareholders. The meeting will consider routine items: election of directors, appointment of auditor, approval to change the registered office province from Québec to Ontario, and a name change to Osisko Gold Group Inc. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer is present. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting notice and proxy circular, not a special situation.
